action.objective: Do I castle? No — instead reroute bishop h1-e1 to put a rook on the open e-file against the exposed Black king while keeping the knight defended.
action.rationale: Analysis budget for broad searches is exhausted and only f4d2 is verified commit-ready (score 366, complete immediate-mate safety, no tactical refutation). With no risk_commit_moves available and no analysis nodes left, f4d2 — Bd2, staying on the dark squares Black's f6-bishop can't fight — is the only sound choice. The verified line f4d2/f7g8/h1e1 confirms the h1-rook can later reach the open e-file, consistent with the plan of pressuring Black's king.
